cards.title: Executive Summary & Core Value
bullets: Addresses quadratic scaling and representation drift in standard autoregressive Transformers.
Formulates Adaptive State Inertia (ASI) with continuous Lyapunov-bounded gating.
Achieves +4.8% accuracy on LongBench while cutting peak memory consumption by 32%.

slides.title: Motivation & Discovery Context
slides.subtitle: Why Standard Attention Fails in Long-Horizon Sequence Reasoning

cards.title: The Long-Context Challenge
bullets: Modern sequence models require maintaining coherent episodic memory across 100k+ tokens.
Standard Softmax Attention exhibits quadratic time and memory complexity $O(L^2)$.
Deep transformer layers suffer from syntactic representation drift, discarding early context.
KV cache memory explosion imposes severe hardware bottlenecks during autoregressive decoding.

cards.title: Current SOTA Bottlenecks
bullets: Linear Recurrence & SSMs (e.g. Mamba, S4) compress states to $O(1)$ memory but struggle with precision associative recall.
Hybrid architectures lack formal Lyapunov stability guarantees under feedback loops.
Static decay coefficients cannot dynamically adapt to variable information density in multi-modal inputs.

side_note.title: Relationship to Our Research
side_note.text: Validates our lab's hypothesis that fixed decay rates in recurrent KV caches trigger catastrophic memory erasure during multi-turn agent dialogues.

slides.title: Paper Classification & Architectural Landscape
slides.subtitle: Taxonomy of Modern Long-Sequence Modeling Paradigms

cards.title: Dense Attention Models
bullets: Examples: Standard Transformer, Transformer-XL, FlashAttention-3.
Strengths: Exact pairwise token association, flawless in-context retrieval.
Limitations: Prohibitive VRAM footprint, memory bandwidth bound.

cards.title: Linear State Spaces (SSM)
bullets: Examples: S4, HiPPO, Mamba-1/2, RWKV-v5.
Strengths: Sub-quadratic training, constant-time inference state update.
Limitations: State capacity bottleneck on multi-hop associative queries.

cards.title: Adaptive State Flow (Ours)
bullets: Proposed: Dual-Inertia State Flow Transformer (ASI).
Key Innovation: Dynamic Lyapunov gating with Hamiltonian energy regularization.
Balance: Combines high-resolution local attention with persistent global state flow.

slides.title: Core Study Objective & Research Gap
slides.subtitle: Bridging Continuous Dynamical Systems and Discrete Token Transformers

cards.title: Central Research Question & Hypothesis
bullets: Can we formulate a continuous state-space update rule with input-dependent eigenvalue inertia that preserves associative precision while guaranteeing constant-memory inference across infinite context windows?

cards.title: Gap 1: Unstable Gating Dynamics
bullets: Heuristic gates in hybrid SSM-Transformers exhibit eigenvalue explosions, causing divergence during long rollout sequences.

cards.title: Gap 2: Loss of Selective Attention
bullets: Pure recurrence collapses high-frequency token associations into low-rank state representations.

cards.title: Gap 3: Gradient Vanishing in Recurrence
bullets: Unconstrained state recurrence leads to vanishing gradient norms across 128k backpropagation spans.

slides.title: Inputs, Assumptions & Theoretical Prerequisites
slides.subtitle: Foundational Constraints for Continuous State Persistence

cards.title: Input Modalities & Representation Space
bullets: Token Sequence: Discrete sequence $\mathbf{x} = (x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_L)$ embedded in $\mathbb{R}^d$.
Multi-Scale Heads: Query, Key, Value projections $Q, K, V$ in $\mathbb{R}^{L \times d_k}$ per head.
Discretization Step: Continuous timescale mapped via learned step size Delta in (0, 1].
Context Length Envelope: Evaluated up to L = 131,072 tokens under single-device streaming.

cards.title: Foundational Assumptions & Invariants
bullets: Assumption 1 (Lyapunov Stability): Gating eigenvalues strictly bounded: Re(lambda_i(A)) < 0.
Assumption 2 (Energy Conservation): Hamiltonian gradient penalty prevents state tensor blowup.
Invariant: State update $S_t$ is strictly $O(1)$ in memory relative to sequence length L.

slides.title: Problem Formulation & State Dynamics
slides.subtitle: Mathematical Derivation of the Adaptive State Inertia Update

cards.title: Continuous State Persistence Formulation
bullets: Core State Recurrence with input-dependent adaptive inertia coefficient alpha_t:
Equation (1): {{MATH:$S_t$ = \alpha_t \odot S_{t-1} + (1 - \alpha_t) \odot (W x_t)}}
Joint Optimization Objective with Hamiltonian Energy Regularization:
Equation (2): {{MATH:\mathcal{L}_{\text{total}} = \mathcal{L}_{\text{task}} + \lambda \sum_{i=1}^N \| \nabla_{\theta_i} \mathcal{H} \|_2^2}}

cards.title: Mathematical Notation & Operator Glossary
bullets: $S_t$ in $\mathbb{R}^{d \times d}$: Latent continuous state matrix capturing long-horizon episodic context.
alpha_t = sigma(W_g x_t): Dynamic inertia gating vector bounded in [0, 1]^d.
H($S_t$): Hamiltonian latent energy function governing state trajectory curvature.
lambda: Global regularization coefficient balancing task loss against gradient smoothness.

slides.subtitle: Dual-Inertia State Flow Transformer with Adaptive Gating

cards.title: High-DPI System Architecture

bullets: High-resolution vector architecture diagram extracted at 300 DPI.
Illustrates parallel token flow through Multi-Head Attention and State Inertia Buffer.

cards.title: Step-by-Step Execution Pipeline
bullets: Step 1 (QKV Projection): Computes local associative attention over sliding window W_local.
Step 2 (Inertia Gating): Computes dynamic coefficient {{MATH:\alpha_t = \sigma(W_g x_t)}} via lightweight linear layer.
Step 3 (Fused State Update): Recurrent state tensor $S_t$ updated in-place via CUDA scan kernel.
Step 4 (Dual-Stream Fusion): Merges attention output with state flow via learned gating projection.

side_note.title: Relationship to Our Research
side_note.text: The dual-stream fusion block matches our planned hybrid architecture, allowing drop-in replacement of existing self-attention layers.

slides.title: Experimental Design & Benchmark Modalities
slides.subtitle: Evaluation Protocols Across Synthetic, Linguistic, and Reasoning Tasks

cards.title: Benchmark Datasets
bullets: LongBench: 16 tasks across multi-doc QA, summarization, and code (32k-128k context).
WikiText-103: Standard autoregressive language modeling perplexity.
LRA (Long Range Arena): Synthetic sequence reasoning (Pathfinder, ListOps).

cards.title: Comparative Baselines
bullets: Transformer-XL: Recurrent segment baseline with quadratic attention.
S4 (Gu et al.): Classic continuous structured state-space model.
RWKV-v5: Linear attention with token-shift recurrence.
Mamba-2 (Dao et al.): State-of-the-art selective state space model.

cards.title: Compute & Training Protocol
bullets: Hardware: Cluster of 8x NVIDIA H100 (80GB SXM5) GPUs.
Optimizer: AdamW (beta_1=0.9, beta_2=0.95, weight_decay=0.1) with cosine warmup.
Kernel Optimization: Custom Triton fused parallel prefix scan for $O(1)$ state memory.

slides.title: Baseline Categories & Trade-off Analysis
slides.subtitle: Pareto Frontier of Accuracy vs Inference Latency

cards.title: Paradigm Comparison & Associative Recall
bullets: Standard Attention maintains perfect retrieval up to 16k context but degrades sharply due to OOM errors at 64k.
Pure SSMs (Mamba, S4) sustain constant latency but experience a 12% accuracy drop on multi-hop associative queries.
ASI (Ours) matches full attention retrieval accuracy while maintaining flat linear latency curve.

cards.title: Pareto Efficiency Analysis
bullets: Throughput: Achieves 3.8x higher decoding speed compared to Transformer-XL.
Context Scaling: Inference memory remains strictly flat from 4k to 128k sequence length.
Energy Efficiency: 41% lower FLOP consumption per token during autoregressive generation.

side_note.title: Relationship to Our Research
side_note.text: The flat inference memory profile confirms our team's design target for deploying 70B parameter models on constrained edge hardware.

slides.title: Ablation Studies & Sensitivity Analysis
slides.subtitle: Dissecting the Impact of Gating, Regularization, and Attention Fusion

cards.title: Component-Wise Ablation Breakdown
bullets: Fixed Decay (alpha = 0.5): -3.7% accuracy degradation; confirms necessity of input-dependent dynamic gating.
No Hamiltonian Loss Penalty (lambda = 0): Model exhibits gradient instability and loss spikes at epoch 14.
Pure Recurrent Stream (No Attention): 25% faster training but suffers 8.2% drop on complex needle-in-haystack retrieval.
Full Dual-Inertia Model: Optimal configuration delivering maximal accuracy and stability.

cards.title: Hyperparameter Sensitivity & Robustness
bullets: Regularization Weight lambda: Stable across broad range lambda in [1e-4, 1e-2]; optimal at lambda = 1e-3.
State Dimension d_state: Performance plateaus at d_state = 128, demonstrating parameter efficiency.
Layer Placement: Interleaving state inertia every 2nd transformer layer yields highest accuracy-to-compute ratio.

slides.title: Author Conclusions & Critical Limitations
slides.subtitle: Rigorous Academic Critique and Identified Boundary Failures

cards.title: Author-Claimed Contributions
bullets: Formulated Adaptive State Inertia (ASI), unifying continuous Lyapunov dynamics with Transformer attention.
Demonstrated Pareto-dominant sequence modeling on LongBench, WikiText-103, and LRA.
Released open-source Triton kernels guaranteeing $O(1)$ state memory during inference.

cards.title: Independent Critical Critique & Blindspots
bullets: Training Wall-Clock Overhead: Eigenvalue modulation adds an 8% training step latency penalty.
Out-of-Distribution Sensitivity: State inertia parameter alpha oscillates under abrupt out-of-domain distribution shifts.
Hardware Dependency: Fused scan kernels are heavily tailored to NVIDIA H100/A100; TPU and Apple Silicon ports remain unoptimized.
